pocketic.canister_cleanup: stop and delete after each completed trial

units.instructions: IC performanceCounter(0), complete batch normalized by operations_per_phase
units.allocated_bytes: Cumulative Motoko heap allocation including temporary objects and retained results; not peak or live heap
units.reclaimed_bytes: Synchronous GC inside the measured interval, included equally for every phase
units.operation_unit: Each case records unit; iterator creation, whole traversal and seek+16 are distinct complete workloads
units.output_bytes: 2-byte correctness reply ok, not the returned object heap size

checks: Both complete input maps and every resulting ordered map checked against independent ordinal-slot bindings
Expected sizes, retained first/middle/final update versions, old values and insertion/deletion flags
Plugin AVL ordering, balance, height and counts on initial and final maps plus both split outputs
Intermediate retained update versions checked for complete contents and size
Created cursors and snapshots fully replayed in expected order, repeatable exhaustion and remaining suffix checked
Consumed traversals/folds checked with bounded order-sensitive checksum and independent count
Predicate find returns earliest matching entry and exact callback count
Construction checks complete bindings and input iterator exhaustion
correctness.timing: Setup, expected values, full validation, replies, end-of-message GC and canister cleanup are outside timing; synchronous GC is inside timing
